title: Stir Up Waters to Catch Fish
hook: Miles lets one wrong assumption sit long enough for the other side to overreach.
counterintuition: Crude provocation only creates noise. Controlled disturbance lets the other side reveal fear, impatience, or confusion while you keep your own judgment intact.
tryThisNow: Take the next request, update, or confrontation and mark where provocation could misfire. Adjust the first move, not the final speech.
keyTakeaway: Disturb the water just enough to reveal reactions while you stay calmer than the target.
